approvers: Main contractor / developer (subcontract package), project manager, my director
reason: Protection is set in the subcontract package and the main contractor decides who pays. I rely on the factory film at no cost, so I would not add about €19/m² on my own. Unless the developer specifies it and pays for it, I have no budget line for this.
objection: In July and August half the façade is in full sun, so I don't know when you can apply it or how it peels off after months of heat. Who pays for the extra cost, and who carries the risk if it leaves residue or damages a coating on a premium block?
instead: Keep the factory film on the profiles and basic cheap taping or sheeting on the glass, with cleaning at handover as the contract requires.
would_change_my_mind: A developer or main contractor who writes it into the spec and pays for it, plus a local reference on a similar block showing fewer snagging callbacks and no residue after a Maltese summer.
